name: Attention-velocity ignition — accel spike + nascent price momentum (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same attention-onset lead as the core accel spec, but requires the price to have ALREADY started ticking up (a small positive short-horizon ret_Nd) so we ride an accel spike that is converting to flow rather than a spike that fizzles. Onset attention on small floats leads price; the momentum confirm filters out chatter with no follow-through. Counterparty is dashboard-lagged retail. DISCONFIRMER: shuffle the attention series and keep price — if the edge is really just the price-momentum leg it survives the shuffle, KILL (the accel must add incremental return over momentum alone). Lead-lag must be asymmetric (+1 strong, -1 ~0). Must clear 4h round-trip fees.
catalyst: attention acceleration confirmed by a nascent up-move
